craft_notes: Sthāyin: answer-verse (she). Rows: row 1 (she-is-supreme). Rupture: dash — sung, then named. Close: form (supreme goddess in supreme form — couplet of supremes). Rejected: 'manifestation' — killed: she kept (devī); skipping second 'supreme' — killed: parā...parā rūpeṇa doublet IS the verse.

lines: Whatever state of Bhairava's is sung like this —
she is supreme: supreme goddess in supreme form.
l4.sanskrit_cite: evaṃvidhā bhairavasya yāvasthā parigīyate | sā parā pararūpeṇa parā devī prakīrtitā

reads_against.argmap: Which state of Bhairava is sung? → The sung state is she — supreme goddess in supreme form.
c1_essence: Sung state: she, supreme goddess in supreme form.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta settling toward śānta (wonder of the unspeakable)
